<action type="say">
Here’s a generic step‑by‑step that matches how most major airline sites/apps work.

On the airline’s website (desktop or mobile browser):
1) Sign in / pull up your trip  
   - Go to the airline’s site.  
   - Log in to your account (or use “My Trips / Manage Trip”).  
   - Enter your last name + confirmation code if needed to open the ATL→BOS booking.

2) Go to “Change flight” (or “Change trip”)  
   - On the trip summary page, look for a button/link like:
     • “Change flight”, “Modify”, or “Change itinerary”.  
   - Click that.

3) Choose only the outbound segment  
   - You’ll usually see both your outbound and return listed.  
   - Select ONLY the ATL → BOS leg (often a checkbox or radio button).  
   - Make sure the return BOS → ATL (or your return route) is NOT selected.

4) Set the new date and time preference  
   - Set the new date to: September 28.  
   - If there’s a time‑of‑day filter, choose “Morning” (or set earliest departure window, e.g., 6:00–12:00).

5) Pick your new flight  
   - From the results ATL → BOS on Sept 28, pick a morning departure that works for you.  
   - Check:
     • Departure time and arrival time  
     • Any connection(s), if applicable  
     • Fare difference and change fee shown on the side or at the bottom

6) Review price and rules  
   - Confirm the total extra cost (fare difference + any change fee).  
   - Check the new ticket rules (refundable/nonrefundable, same baggage rules, etc.).

7) Confirm the change  
   - Continue to the confirmation/payment screen.  
   - If there’s an additional charge, enter payment details and submit.  
   - Wait for the final confirmation page and note the new times.

8) Verify the itinerary  
   - On the final itinerary, verify:
     • Outbound now shows ATL → BOS on Sept 28, morning.  
     • Return is still on the original date and time, unchanged.  
   - Download/print or save the updated confirmation email.

On the airline’s mobile app (if you prefer):
1) Open the app and sign in.  
2) Tap “Trips” / “My Trips” and open the ATL→BOS booking.  
3) Tap “Change flight” or “Change” on the outbound segment.  
4) Select only the outbound leg, set date to Sept 28, filter for morning.  
5) Choose the new flight, review any extra cost, and tap through to confirm.  
6) Reopen the trip in the app and verify:
   - Outbound is Sept 28, morning.  
   - Return segment is the same as before.

If you tell me:
- Your exact current outbound and return times, and  
- A rough earliest/latest time you’re willing to leave on Sept 28,  
I can suggest what to look for (e.g., “aim for Flight XYZ around 8–9am, nonstop, arrives ~11am”) so you know which options to prefer on the airline’s site.</action>
